We are looking for a Specialist IT Endpoint Management profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you’ll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you’ll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Architecture & Strategy

  • Develop and design a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures, standards, and governance models.
  • Ensure that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements are embedded into endpoint architectures and operational processes.
  • Evaluate, design, and implement new endpoint technologies and solutions to continuously improve the digital workplace experience.
  • Lead endpoint management projects from planning and design through implementation and operational transition.

Endpoint Operations & Management

  • Provide Level 2/3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
  • Manage incidents through their full lifecycle, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
  • Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management services.
  • Configure, test, and optimize device policies, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and endpoint security controls.
  • Monitor endpoint compliance, coordinate remediation activities, and support device lifecycle management processes.
  • Support onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning, and deployment activities for end users.

Software Deployment & Continuous Improvement

  • Oversee software packaging, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management activities for business applications and endpoint platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application deployment and device management issues.
  • Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
  • Participate in pilot deployments, testing initiatives, automation efforts, and continuous service improvement programs.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Manage external service providers and coordinate interfaces between IT Security, Infrastructure, Workplace Services, and Operations teams.
  • Act as a technical advisor and escalation point for endpoint-related topics across the organization.
  • Support knowledge sharing and technical enablement within the Endpoint Management team.

Documentation & Governance

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture standards, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Document recurring issues, standard solutions, and architectural decisions.
  • Ensure endpoint management processes and documentation align with security and compliance requirements.
  • 4+ years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
  • Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
  • Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • A high level of English is required (C1)
  • To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
  • We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring
  • Make valuable contacts within Drees & Sommer and expand your professional network
  • Modern workplace and equipment; Teams meetings and participation in corporate workshops
  • Receive compensation that gives you financial independence during your studies

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

raw.excerpt: The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
raw.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base
  • Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
  • Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We’re a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

  • Swift Programming Language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Experience in Multithreading Programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
  • A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
  • Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
  • Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

raw.title: Implementation Manager, Mid-Market
raw.excerpt: What Do We Do? Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommerce.
raw.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Pressed Juicery, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

What You’re Applying for:

We’re looking for an Implementation Manager, Mid-Market to lead the onboarding journey for new Triple Whale customers. The role is equal parts consultative and coordinative. You’ll quickly understand what each customer is actually trying to accomplish, then drive the people, sequencing, and detail that get them there — owning their launch from contract signature through full go-live.

It is hands-on, technical, and has genuine volume behind it. You’ll run a full slate of implementations at once, which means getting very good at making a repeatable process work without any single customer feeling like they are on a conveyor belt. You’ll configure and validate the measurement foundation, be accountable for the accuracy of what the customer sees on day one, and be among the first people to onboard customers onto Moby, our AI agent — teaching teams to run AI-led workflows and automations rather than just read dashboards.

You’ll help set the standard of what good looks like for Mid-market onboarding.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead consultative discovery with new customers — clarify business objectives, surface constraints, and translate desired outcomes into the success criteria you drive toward during onboarding.
  • Own end-to-end delivery for a high-volume book of Mid-Market implementations, from kickoff through go-live and into the handoff to Customer Success — adapting how you run each onboarding to the customer’s goals and setup while protecting speed to value.
  • Configure the technical foundation of each launch — tracking and pixel implementation, platform integrations (Shopify, Meta, Google, Klaviyo, Amazon, and more), and data source connections.
  • Advise on customer tech stacks and recommend integration best practices, with enough API and webhook fluency to know what is possible — and to pull in Solutions Architecture early when a launch genuinely needs custom work.
  • Validate attribution and data accuracy before go-live — and when something looks wrong, describe it precisely enough that Support and Product can act on it, and clearly enough that the customer knows what it means for them.
  • Onboard customers onto Moby, Triple Whale’s AI agent, so teams leave onboarding running AI-led workflows and automations that make the rest of their stack smarter.
  • Run training and enablement — one-to-one where it matters, one-to-many where it scales — to drive adoption and confidence in the platform.
  • Own the handoff to Customer Success: document what was configured, what the customer is measuring, what adoption looks like at go-live, and what remains open, so the CSM starts from a real baseline rather than a blank page.
  • Influence the stakeholders you do not manage — build the internal champion, get the right people to show up, and move a stalled customer team without formal authority.
  • Apply structured risk management across a large book — identify exposure early, mitigate it deliberately, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a problem.
  • Monitor implementation health across your entire portfolio, balancing speed to value against quality and protecting both.
  • Keep project tooling, documentation, and account records current without being reminded.
  • Partner proactively with Customer Success, Product, Support, and Marketing to resolve issues and streamline the path to launch.
  • Spot the patterns across your book and turn them into better onboarding standards — kickoff structure, handoff criteria, templates, and what “done” actually means.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–4+ years in implementation, onboarding, technical account management, or customer success at a SaaS company.
  • A consultative instinct — you ask about the business problem before reaching for the configuration screen.
  • Strong project management skills — you plan the work, sequence dependencies, and deliver a high volume of concurrent projects on time, without dropping details and without close supervision.
  • Enough technical fluency to be credible: you understand tracking and pixel implementation, integrations, APIs and webhooks well enough to explain what is happening, what it means for the customer, and what has to happen next — without needing someone to translate it for you.
  • Working knowledge of the martech and ecommerce stack — Shopify, Meta and Google Ads, email and SMS platforms — and how attribution actually behaves across them.
  • The ability to balance technical depth with clarity: you can go deep with an analyst, then explain the same thing to a founder without losing either of them.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders you have no authority over — you can hold a customer team to their commitments and re-engage one that has gone quiet.
  • Comfort working from a repeatable playbook, and the judgment to know when a customer needs something off-script.
  • Disciplined risk management: you spot exposure early and act on it rather than reporting it.
  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to teach customers a new way of working, not just a new piece of software.
  • Knowledge of retail and eCommerce business needs, processes, and best practices.
  • An interest in improving how the team works, not just running your own book.

Bonus Points For

  • Previous experience in SaaS, MarTech, analytics, or eCommerce platforms.
  • Background in customer success, account management, or professional services.

Our Values

  • We Are Customer Obsessed: From our mission to every detailed project, everything we do is designed to create a positive impact for our customers.
  • We Move (Very!) Quickly: The speed at which we work, iterate, and deliver value is our most competitive advantage.
  • We Are Trustworthy: Candor, directness, and honest communication helps us learn, grow and improve so we can win together.
  • We Are Curious: We extend beyond our comfort zone and ask questions that guide us towards new, creative, and bold paths.
  • We Act Like A Mensch: We act with honor, integrity and empathy, and have deep respect for our customers and each other.

Our compensation ranges are set using benchmarks from growth-stage companies and factor in function, level, and location—so everything stays balanced and competitive. The range listed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salary across all U.S. locations.

Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred? Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way! They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

raw.excerpt: About Curology:Curology’s mission is to make effective, personalized skincare accessible.
raw.description:
About Curology:

Curology’s mission is to make effective, personalized skincare accessible. We were founded by dermatologists who believe everyone should have access to skincare products that actually work. Today, our licensed dermatology providers have helped millions of patients across all 50 states make that mission a reality.

We combine expert medical care with personalized prescription formulas and dermatologist-developed skincare essentials to deliver science-backed solutions that meet people where they are. Join us in our mission to transform skin health and enhance lives—one patient at a time.

Mission of the Role:

The mission of the Senior Data Analyst is to turn ambiguous business questions into analytics solutions that inform decisions — owning the work end to end, from problem framing through delivery and adoption. Reporting to the Analytics Lead, this role sits on the Data Analytics team and partners directly with stakeholders across the business.

Success depends on partnering with stakeholders to define the real question behind a request, recommend the right approach, and deliver visualizations and narratives that make the answer usable by non-technical audiences. The Senior Data Analyst connects each analysis to the broader business context rather than answering questions in isolation, and is accountable for the accuracy, documentation, and durability of what they ship.

Essential Functions and Impact Areas:

Stakeholder Consultation & Problem Framing

  • Partner with business stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Marketing, and Product functional groups to translate open-ended questions into scoped analytical problems with defined success criteria.
  • Ask the follow-up questions that surface the decision behind the request, and push back when the requested output will not answer it.
  • Recommend the analytical approach, including when a request warrants a reusable data asset rather than a one-off pull.
  • Set expectations on scope and timeline, and communicate changes as work progresses.

End-to-End Project Ownership

  • Own analytics projects from intake through delivery and adoption without requiring day-to-day direction.
  • Source, validate, and model data in SQL to produce analysis-ready datasets.
  • Document methodology, assumptions, and known limitations so results can be reproduced and reused.
  • Build analytical assets that compound — reusable datasets, dashboards, and metric definitions rather than disposable outputs.
  • Verify results against source systems before delivery, and surface discrepancies rather than reconciling them silently.

Data Visualization & Storytelling

  • Design Tableau dashboards that answer a defined question for a defined audience, prioritizing clarity over comprehensiveness.
  • Translate analysis into a clear narrative — what the data shows, what it means, and what decision it supports — calibrating depth to non-technical and senior audiences.
  • Distinguish findings from interpretation and state confidence levels explicitly.

Business Context & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Help elevate the analytics function at Curology by supporting leadership with the insights they need to manage the business and measure outcomes.
  • Connect analysis to how the broader business operates across patients, subscription lifecycle, and downstream financial impact.
  • Partner with data engineering, analytics peers, and business teams to align on metric definitions and prevent duplicate sources of truth.
  • Surface risks and opportunities stakeholders have not asked about.
  • Handle patient and business data in line with Curology’s privacy and security standards.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in an analytics role delivering analysis directly to business stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization against large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, or similar).
  • Tableau experience building and maintaining production dashboards used by business teams, not one-off visuals.
  • Track record of owning analytics projects end to end, translating ambiguous business questions into a defined approach and recommending the method rather than executing a specified request.
  • Experience defining KPIs and developing metrics, scorecards, and performance reporting used by business teams and leadership.
  • Experience with customer behavior analysis — retention, churn, cohort, and LTV — and defining segmentation used across analytics and reporting.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences in both written and live formats.
  • Proficiency using AI as an execution partner to accelerate query drafts, design mockups, and polish outputs, while remaining fully capable of producing the work without AI. Corrects AI output and owns the quality of what ships.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience in a DTC subscription business.
  • Experience supporting lifecycle or CRM marketing teams.
  • Familiarity with email and SMS performance metrics and campaign measurement.

Benefits

Location:

  • Remote (US)

Benefits & Perks:

  • 💰 Competitive compensation and equity package (RSUs)
  • 🥼 Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, FSA and HSA, supplemental coverages (critical illness, accident, hospitalization), and 401(k)
  • 🧘🏻‍♀️ Access to wellbeing perks, including OneMedical, Spring Health, SoFi, and Employee Assistance Program
  • 🌴 Flexible paid time off and holiday policy
  • 🐣 Paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents)
  • 💜 Employee donation matching program
  • 🫱🏻‍🫲🏽 Culture Committee and employee resource groups for virtual and in-person connectivity
  • ✨ Complimentary VIP Subscription to Curology or Agency, plus online retail discount

The estimated base salary range for this role is $130,000 – $160,000 per year, plus a competitive equity package and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including location, skills, experience, and job-related expertise.

Our Typical Interview Process*:

*Subject to change based on role

  • 30 minute Recruiter screen (phone)
  • 30-45 minute interview with a Hiring Manager (Google Meet or Zoom)
  • 30-45 minute technical assessment, case study, or peer interview(s) (Google Meet or Zoom)
  • 30-45 minute final round interview with Hiring Manager or Team Leader (Google Meet or Zoom)

Candidates Using AI:

At Curology, we invest in responsible use of AI tools to help our teams innovate and solve challenges. Please feel free to use AI to:

  • Refine and polish your application materials
  • Research Curology and the role
  • Prepare for your interviews

Please refrain from using AI tools during live interviews, unless our hiring team has instructed you otherwise. (Note: These guidelines do not apply to reasonable accommodations. If you require a reasonable accommodation at any point during our interview process, please notify your recruiter.)

Curology’s Operating Principles:

  • One Curology, One Team
  • Be Candid, Then Commit
  • Lead with Curiosity
  • Trust but Verify
  • Use Peripheral Vision
  • Move Quickly, Think Deeply

Job Summary:TheProduct Managerowns the end-to-end lifecycle of new and existingdigital applications, ensuring they solve real user problems and support business growth. This role combines product management with customer experience research, conductingmarket and usability research and developing adoption strategies to support successfulproduct launches and long term user retention.

What does a day in the life of a Product Manager look like?

  • Own and define product features and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and the customer journey.

  • Design and execute market research and competitive analysis to identify market gaps, user personas, and emerging customer needs.

  • Conduct customer discovery, user interviews, and usability testing to identify friction

points and validate prototypes before development.

  • Develop onboarding flows and adoption strategies to support user acquisition and product adoption.

  • Partner with Engineering, UX/UI Designers, Customer Success, and Marketing to translate customer insights into feature specifications (PRDs) and user stories.

  • Lead the creation and maintenance of product documentation, including feature specifications, release notes, and SOPs for internal teams.

  • Define, track, and analyze key product metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, churn, DAU/MAU, NPS) to inform feature iteration.

  • Partner with customer-facing teams to deliver product enablement training, ensuring support staff are aligned with the customer journey.

  • Adhere to company policies and procedures

  • Meet or exceed performance targets for related KPIs

  • Continuously improve knowledge of product management methodologies, customer experience research, and industry best practices through training and learning initiatives

  • Collaborate with other departments as needed

  • Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers and colleagues at all times

  • Perform other duties as assigned

What are the required qualifications of a Product Manager?

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in product management, preferably owning digital products, mobile/web applications, or SaaS solutions.

  • Hands-on experience conducting qualitative user research (e.g., usability testing, customer interviews) and quantitative analysis.

  • Experience applying testing and optimization frameworks (e.g., A/B testing, funnel analysis, onboarding flow design) to improve product adoption.

  • Experience with product analytics platforms (e.g., Firebase, Amplitude, Hotjar, GA4) and agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, ClickUp).

  • Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to translate user feedback into clear technical requirements.

Ready to make a difference?

We are seeking a Lead Transmission Line Engineer to support and advance our growing transmission engineering practice. In this role, you will provide senior‑level technical expertise, lead complex design and analysis work, mentor junior engineers, and ensure high‑quality deliverables across a wide range of transmission line engineering projects for utility clients.

Our team is passionate about re‑engineering the way electric utilities solve their toughest challenges. We combine innovation, technical rigor, and a client‑first mindset to deliver exceptional engineering solutions—from detailed design to advanced modeling and analysis.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Quality of life: Fully remote, flexible schedule, work-life balance

  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan

The Ideal Candidate

  • Highly motivated engineering leader who takes pride in delivering exceptional services and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on schedule

  • Proactive team leader who understands how to motivate, direct, and manage the work of others

  • Strong communicator who effectively defines and prioritizes group objectives, trains and mentors individually and collectively, and contributes to a positive team dynamic

  • Demonstrates initiative, self-sufficiency, and the ability to work productively from a home office without direct supervision

  • Committed to continuous learning and process improvement, consistently seeking opportunities to enhance quality and efficiency

  • Embraces new responsibilities and eagerly acquires new skill sets as needed to support evolving project and industry demands.

  • Perform key engineering studies such as conductor economic evaluations, lightning performance, grounding calculations, and electrical clearance determinations per NESC and applicable standards.

  • Interpret and apply regulatory requirements including NERC, FERC, and regional standards, and ensure compliance across project deliverables.

  • Prepare and review technical documentation such as specifications, data sheets, RFQs, bid evaluations, vendor drawings, and purchase recommendations.

  • Collaborate with project managers on scopes, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, construction support, and change order management.

  • Perform and review QA/QC for engineering deliverables, production drawings, CAD outputs, and construction administration activities, resolving design‑related field issues.

  • Conduct and lead field inspections, measurements, calculations, and installation reviews for both public and private clients.

  • Develop and present technical reports, support marketing and business development efforts, and build strong relationships with clients and contractors.

  • Provide mentorship, leadership, and guidance to less experienced engineers, ensuring effective cross‑discipline communication and adherence to company safety, quality, and performance standards.

  • 8+ years of experience working in PLS‑CADD

  • People management and mentorship experience

  • Experience directing and reviewing the work of others for quality assurance and delivering constructive feedback

  • Ability to plan and manage assignments and clearly communicate barriers to complete tasks on budget/schedule

What we would like you to have (preferred qualifications):

  • Knowledge of the practical application of industry standards such as: NESC, IEEE, ANSI, FERC‑881, and FAC‑008 standards

  • Initiative to embrace continuous learning toward becoming an expert on the programs and services you represent

raw.description:
POSITION TITLE:IT Support Team Lead

Supervised by: IT Operations Manager

Supervises: IT Support Team Members

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt / Full-Time

POSITION SUMMARY. MediQuant helps more than 250 health systems and hospital networks retire, secure, and modernize their legacy healthcare data. As IT Support Team Lead, you own the frontline experience for every employee and client who depends on MediQuant’s systems working — and working securely.

The IT Support Team Lead owns the day-to-day performance, responsiveness, and service quality of MediQuant’s IT Support function — service desk operations, the ITSM platform, and end-user technology across the business. This role leads the IT Support Team, sets support standards and processes, and partners closely with the IT Operations Manager on roadmap, staffing, and service-level commitments.

JOB DUTIES and ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS. A qualified individual must be able to perform these essential functions of the job as listed, with or without accommodation.

  1. Service Desk Operations & Incident Management
    1. Owns day-to-day service desk operations, planning, and execution for MediQuant’s IT Support function — both internal and client-facing.
    2. Manages escalated incidents through to resolution; documents root cause and resolution in knowledge base articles for future reference.
    3. Establishes staff working schedules and task allocation to ensure coverage aligned with contractual and client SLA/OLA requirements.
    4. Monitors and reports on services and service levels, operating within the SLAs/OLAs negotiated by the IT Operations Manager.
    5. Ensures the team maintains on-call/escalation coverage, escalating unresolved gaps to the IT Operations Manager.
  2. ITSM Platform, Documentation & Training
    1. Manages and administers the ITSM/ticketing platform SolarWinds Service Desk, including workflows, knowledge base articles, and reporting.
    2. Maintains and updates dashboards for system health and ITSM metrics using existing templates and tooling.
    3. Ensures documentation and knowledge articles for recurring incidents, support procedures, and automation tooling are created and maintained.
    4. Develops staff ability to co-manage the ITSM platform; leads the team in developing training materials and onboarding documentation for support processes.
  3. Compliance & Data Security
    1. Ensures data integrity, access controls, and secure handling of Confidential Data and PHI across all systems and support interactions under this role’s oversight.
    2. Executes HIPAA compliance controls relevant to the IT Support function, including evidence collection supporting MediQuant’s HITRUST r2 certification. The IT Operations Manager holds operational compliance accountability; the Information Security Manager holds final compliance program ownership and audit sign-off.
    3. Partners with Security/Compliance leadership on audit readiness, risk assessments, and remediation tracking for support-related findings.
  4. Projects & Portfolio Governance
    1. Provides input into IT Support-domain project plans — resourcing needs, timeline risks, and dependencies — and functions as a project resource on cross-functional IT projects when support expertise is required. Flags risk or slippage on owned initiatives to the IT Operations Manager.
    2. Coordinates with the PMO/project management function on schedule and dependencies for support-related initiatives.
    3. Independently verifies the actual state of support systems, tickets, and initiatives owned by this role, rather than relying solely on team- or vendor-reported status.
    4. Proactively escalates risk, slippage, or emerging issues to the IT Operations Manager in advance of impact, with a recommended course of action.
    5. Develops and evolves the IT Support services roadmap in partnership with the IT Operations Manager, aligning with the Infrastructure & Database Team Lead on shared platforms and dependencies.
  5. Stakeholder Service & Process Improvement
    1. Leads the support service approval process.
    2. Ensures service awareness across all client onboarding activities, production deployments, and Go-Live support.
    3. Ensures customer service excellence by monitoring tickets, reviewing customer feedback, and driving continuous improvement of the support experience.
    4. Partners with HR, Implementation Services, Sales, or other business functions, as directed by the IT Operations Manager, to document new operational workflows that touch IT Support systems or tooling.
  6. Team Leadership & Performance Management
    1. Builds 30-60-90-day onboarding plans and conducts onboarding one-on-ones for new hires; provides input for their early (90-day) performance review.
    2. Holds regular one-on-ones and conducts performance reviews at agreed intervals (90-day, semi-annual, annual) against competency standards set by Technology Leadership; the IT Operations Manager holds final accountability for ratings, salary discussions, and issuance.
    3. Builds a day-to-day learning environment; identifies and nominates staff for training, coursework, and certifications. The IT Operations Manager approves and funds training and certification investment.
    4. Manages timekeeping and leave administration for direct reports, including approval of timecards, PTO, and schedule adjustments to maintain operational coverage and payroll accuracy.
    5. Interviews and evaluates candidates and recommends hire/no-hire decisions, partnering with Human Resources throughout; the IT Operations Manager holds final hiring sign-off.
    6. Recommends performance ratings and Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) to the IT Operations Manager for sign-off, and implements approved PIPs and other approved personnel actions.
  7. Team Resourcing & Succession
    1. Owns daily task, shift, and queue allocation to meet coverage and delivery commitments for the team.
    2. Identifies and closes cross-training and skill-gap coverage needs within the team.
    3. Translates IT Operations Manager-set team goals into day-to-day priorities and assignments.
    4. Provides input on intra-team staffing and FTE allocation; the IT Operations Manager owns final allocation decisions.
    5. Recommends succession candidates and escalates staffing or resourcing risk to the IT Operations Manager.

QUALIFICATIONS

Competencies:

  • Critical Thinking
  • Technical Acumen — IT Support & ITSM
  • Professionalism and Composure
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Flexibility and Self-Motivation
  • Documentation Skills
  • Team Leadership and Coaching

Required Education and Experience:

  • Associate degree (or actively pursuing) in a technical field of study, with certificates in a computer-related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of IT support/service desk experience, including 1+ years in a lead or supervisory capacity.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA regulations involving PHI.
  • Hands-on administration experience with an ITSM/ticketing platform (e.g., Freshservice, ServiceNow, SolarWinds Service Desk), including knowledge base and workflow configuration.
  • Experience with Office 365 and collaboration technologies.
  • Working familiarity with SQL or relational databases sufficient to query and troubleshoot support issues (administration or development not required).

Additional Eligibility Qualifications:

  • ITIL Foundation certification, or equivalent ITSM framework experience.
  • Scripting/automation experience (e.g., PowerShell) for support process improvement.
  • Experience supporting healthcare or other highly regulated clients.

Work Environment. Employees may work from our corporate headquarters or work from home. Employees may at times be required to travel to headquarters for meetings or company events. Remote workers will be provided with a company laptop and are responsible for maintaining access to high-speed internet.

Physical Demands. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit for long periods of time, stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work. This is a full-time position, and the hours of work and days are typically Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Some flexibility in hours is allowed, but the employee must be available during the “core” work hours of 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

Travel.Incumbent may occasionally experience some out-of-the-area and overnight travel.

Work Authorization. In compliance with Federal employment laws, MediQuant will verify the identity and employment authorization of each person hired. MediQuant participates in the Federal E-Verify program.

Security Clearance. Must be able to pass all security clearances mandated by various government contracts as well as client hospital/healthcare security requirements. Any employee working on government projects will be required to successfully pass a government background check and receive a Common Access Card (CAC). Additionally, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen and will be subject to a Public Trust security background investigation and must meet requirements to obtain a Department of Defense (DOD) network account.

AAP/EEO Statement.MediQuant, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

Compliance. Employees shall comply with all MediQuant policies, state and federal laws, regulations, and contractual obligations when accessing MediQuant or client Confidential Data, Confidential Information, and Information Assets.

Other Duties.Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time.

At Lumivero, we build software that helps researchers, educators, and organizations around the world transform data into meaningful insights. Our engineering teams develop secure, scalable SaaS solutions that support thousands of users globally.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, automating manual processes, and building reliable cloud platforms. If you're passionate about Kubernetes, cloud technologies, automation, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

NOTE: This is a Full-Time opportunity (employed through our Employer of Record partner)

This position is intended to be performed from Mexico or another country in Latin America.

About the Team

You'll join a collaborative, globally distributed Technology team responsible for the reliability, scalability, and security of Lumivero's SaaS platform. Our DevOps engineers partner closely with Software Engineering, Security, and Product teams to build and maintain the infrastructure that enables rapid, reliable software delivery.

This is an opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies while having a direct impact on the platform that powers our products.

What You'll Do

As a DevOps Engineer, you'll help ensure our production platform remains secure, reliable, and highly available while continuously improving how software is built and deployed.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes environments using kOps and Helm.
  • Administer AWS infrastructure and supporting cloud services.
  • Support Azure environments and related services.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code and Pipelines as Code solutions.
  • Automate deployments, Docker image creation, and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and maintain scalable environments that support our growing SaaS platform.
  • Monitor production systems and troubleshoot issues using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support production incidents.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve deployment reliability and operational excellence.
  • Continuously improve platform automation, security, and operational efficiency.
  • Able to participate in On-call rotations

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or similar infrastructure role.
  • Experience managing Docker containers and Kubernetes environments.
  • Strong Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Pipelines as Code.
  • Experience working with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or ArgoCD.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Professional working proficiency in English (CEFR B2 or higher). Candidates should be comfortable participating in technical discussions, collaborating in meetings, and reading and writing technical documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with:

  • Azure services including AKS, RBAC, Virtual Networks, and Application Gateway

With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.

Job Description:

Role Overview

As a Senior Sales Engineer you will support the EMEA Sales team by translating customer requirements into optimized energy storage solutions and compelling technical proposals. Acting as a trusted technical advisor, you will guide customers throughout the sales process, support contract negotiations, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver successful energy storage projects. This role combines strong technical expertise, customer engagement, and commercial awareness to help drive Fluence's growth across the region

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with the EMEA Sales teams to transform customer requirements into compelling, optimized technical energy storage solution proposals.
  • Build deep expertise in energy storage technologies and serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing product configuration guidance and support to Sales teams.
  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of sales tools and support materials that drive business success.
  • Lead the evaluation and selection of installation contractor proposals, supporting seamless system integration and turnkey solution delivery.
  • Collaborate with Sales teams to navigate and negotiate technical aspects of customer contracts.
  • Capture and translate customer technical and application requirements into valuable insights that help shape future product roadmaps.
  • Support the development of system designs that meet applicable local codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proactively identify technical deviations and work collaboratively across teams and supporting functions to resolve them efficiently.
  • Travel throughout EMEA, engaging directly with customers, partners, and stakeholders across the region.

Qualifications/Experience

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of two years of relevant professional experience within the power industry.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex technical challenges while clearly communicating solutions and outcomes.
  • Previous experience with offer management and/or technical contract review.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms and engineering tools such as Salesforce and CAD.
  • Proven experience in energy storage, solar, power generation, or industrial balance of plant environments (including EPC projects).
  • Understanding of local standards, codes, and regulatory requirements.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation and the ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple parallel activities.
  • Demonstrated ownership mentality with a strong drive to close opportunities and contribute to Fluence's business objectives.
  • Excellent coordination, collaboration, and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a highly collaborative, fast-paced, and informally structured environment.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.

Our Culture

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.

Unleash Voices

We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.

Customer Fluent

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.

Infinite Impact

We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.

All In

We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

About the Opportunity

DMI, LLC is seeking an Applications Programmer, Level III (Appian) to provide a senior, certified Appian professional responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining complex business process management applications on the Appian low-code platform, and for administering the program's Appian instance. The role owns operations and maintenance of a production portfolio of regulatory review workflows and mentors less experienced developers. Appian platform experience is mandatory and cannot be substituted with experience on other low-code or business process management platforms.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain complex business process management applications on the Appian low-code platform.
  • Administer the program's Appian instance, including cloud platform administration, environment configuration, and deployment management.
  • Deliver operations and maintenance support, bug fixes, and minor enhancements of under 200 hours to a production portfolio of approximately 26 active Appian workflows supporting multiple regulatory program offices.
  • Configure and optimize workflow processes, forms, records, and interfaces to support regulatory review, content management, and search functions.
  • Integrate Appian workflows with external application programming interfaces, content management repositories, forms management platforms, and messaging services.
  • Lead and mentor less experienced developers, providing technical direction and code review on Appian development standards.
  • Implement artificial intelligence and large language model capabilities within Appian workflows to automate document processing and data extraction.
  • Support release planning, unit and integration testing, Section 508 accessibility remediation, and release package preparation under the agency's lifecycle process.

Qualifications

Education and Years of Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related technical field. An additional four years of directly relevant application development experience may substitute for the degree.

  • Current Appian certification. The contract requires a certified, senior-level professional without naming a specific credential; DMI's screening standard is Appian Certified Senior Developer or Appian Certified Lead Developer.
  • Demonstrated Appian platform administration experience, including Appian Cloud environment administration, deployment, and configuration management.
  • Demonstrated experience maintaining and enhancing a production portfolio of Appian process models and applications in an operations and maintenance context.
  • Experience integrating Appian with external systems through application programming interfaces and web services.
  • Experience providing technical leadership and mentorship to other Appian developers.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Moderate Risk (Tier 2) Public Trust background investigation and a government PIV credential.

Required Skills & Certifications:

  • Appian Certified Lead Developer credential.
  • Experience with Appian 25.x on Appian Cloud platform-as-a-service.
  • Experience integrating Appian with Documentum, Adobe Experience Manager, Apache Kafka, or Apache Solr.
  • Experience embedding artificial intelligence or large language model services into Appian process automation.
  • Federal regulatory, licensing, or submission review workflow experience.

Citizenship Status Required: Must be a U.S. Citizen

Physical Requirements: None required for this position.

Location: Remote, US

$102,495

Median Salary Rate

$128,119

Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.

Section 1: Position Summary

The Director of Government Savings Operations is responsible for the strategic oversight, leadership, and optimization of processing functions within Government Savings. This role leads a large organization of associates, team leads, and managers while also providing oversight and direction to a global operations team operating in a dotted-line reporting structure. The Director is accountable for driving operational excellence through process improvement, standardization, and scalable solutions across all teams.

This leader plays a critical role in shaping and executing the operational strategy by leveraging technology, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), to improve efficiency, accuracy, and client experience. A strong understanding of transfer agency systems and operational workflows is essential to inform automation opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

The role requires end-to-end accountability for key performance indicators (KPIs), including budget adherence, SLA performance, quality, productivity, and escalation management. The Director must ensure consistent execution of policies, procedures, and controls while maintaining agility to respond to changing volumes, peak seasons, and evolving client needs. Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and cross-functional collaboration are essential to achieving business objectives and delivering high-quality service to partners and clients.

Proactively adopt, protect and boldly embrace emerging technologies (AI, automation, etc.), platforms, and evolving practices that accelerate transformational growth and advance Ascensus’ mission and client commitments.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction for Government Savings operations, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and client expectations
  • Drive process improvement, standardization, and operational optimization initiatives across all teams, including global partners
  • Identify, prioritize, and implement automation opportunities leveraging RPA, AI, and other enabling technologies to enhance efficiency and scalability
  • Maintain accountability for key operational KPIs including budget adherence, SLA performance, quality, productivity, and escalations
  • Oversee a diverse range of transaction processing and client service activities across phone and processing teams
  • Lead workforce planning efforts, including staffing models, capacity planning, and resource alignment across peak and non-peak periods
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and development to managers and team leads, fostering a high-performance culture and strong leadership pipeline
  • Partner with peer leaders to balance resources, share best practices, and drive consistency across operational functions
  • Ensure effective governance of policies, procedures, and controls to maintain compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements
  • Collaborate with technology, product, and business partners to enhance systems and improve end-to-end operational workflows
  • Lead and support global operations through a dotted-line structure to ensure alignment, consistency, and performance across regions
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders regarding performance, initiatives, and client needs
  • Lead escalation management, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis to prevent recurrence
  • Support training and development initiatives aligned with business objectives and evolving operational needs
  • Partner with senior leadership to develop and execute the strategic roadmap for Government Savings operations
  • Facilitate and participate in partner and client discussions as needed to represent operational priorities and performance
  • Ensure the protection, security, and proper handling of all confidential data in accordance with organizational policies
  • Demonstrate and reinforce organizational values, including I-Client Service philosophy and Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always®

Section 3: Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements

Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of professional experience; 7+ years of leadership experience in financial services or operations management
Demonstrated experience leading large, multi-level teams, including global or matrixed organizations
Strong background in process improvement, operational excellence, and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or similar)
Experience implementing or leveraging automation technologies such as RPA, AI, or workflow tools in an operations environment
Proven ability to manage and drive performance against KPIs including budget, SLAs, quality, productivity, and client satisfaction
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
Demonstrated technical aptitude and ability to partner effectively with technology teams
Experience with workforce planning and capacity management in a high-volume environment
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with flexibility during peak seasons
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Knowledge of 529 savings plans preferred but not required
Willingness to travel as needed for business and leadership development

RN Crisis Care Triage

Sedgwick is currently seeking Triage Nurses to join our Crisis Care team. This is a remote part-time position working 32-hours per week. The team operates 24/7, with the greatest staffing needs during afternoon, evening hours, overnight and weekends.

As a nurse at Sedgwick, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career while advocating for patients in a nontraditional clinical setting.

  • Apply your medical/clinical or rehabilitation knowledge and experience to assist in the management of complex medical conditions, treatment planning and recovery from illness or injury.

  • Work in the best of both worlds - a rewarding career making an impact on the health and lives of others, and a remote work environment.

  • Enable our Caring counts® mission supporting injured employees from some of the world’s best brands and organizations.

  • Celebrate your career achievements and each other through professional development opportunities, continuing education credits, team building initiatives and more.

PRIMARY PURPOSE: Triages incoming catastrophic injury referral calls from clients; gathers vital case details, obtains and provides medical status updates to the customer, and assigns a Field Case Manager (FCM) for onsite visits as appropriate. Ensures that client service guidelines are followed and communicated to the appropriate parties and promotes quality cost-effective outcomes through communication and available resources.

ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE? We are looking for enthusiastic candidates who thrive in a collaborative environment, who are driven to deliver great work.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES MAY INCLUDE:

  • Provides professional and timely responses to incoming catastrophic referral calls from clients, applying all phases of the nursing process, i.e. assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation when triaging calls.

  • Triages the catastrophic referral utilizing critical reasoning, the department triage log, and associated workflow; utilizes customer specific guidelines to obtain pertinent data.

  • Identifies life-threatening emergencies and recommends appropriate interventions.

  • Assigns appropriate Field Case Manager assignment and facilitates initial onsite hospital visit for the claim.

  • Maintains communication with the customer, Client Service Director, and Claims Examiner providing timely updates on changes in injured worker status and FCM estimated time of arrival.

  • Communicates phone advice in a calm manner, ensuring it is properly received and understood.

  • Ensures triage benchmarks are met, activity is professionally documented and enters incident data into computer system.

  • Educates the assigned FCM on Sedgwick benchmarks and customer specific guidelines.

  • Maintains ongoing communication with the client, Client Service Director, and Claims Examiner until the assigned Field Case Manager arrives onsite.

  • Adheres to quality assurance standards.

Education & Licensing

Bachelor's degree in nursing (BSN) from an accredited college or university preferred. Licenses as required. Active unrestricted RN license issued in a state or territory of the United States required.

TAKING CARE OF YOU

  • Seeks innovative customer solutions.

  • Craves cutting edge opportunities.

  • Wants dynamic company culture.

  • Passion about creativity.

  • Seeks ongoing learning as a person and professional.

  • Thrives when solving challenging problems.

  • Wants achievements to be celebrated.

  • We offer a diverse and comprehensive benefits including medical, dental vision, 401K, PTO and more beginning your first day.

Fractional Data Analyst (6–8 Hours per Week) – FinTech / Remote

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING

Location: Remote
Working Pattern: Fractional – approximately 6–8 hours per week
Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage FinTech developing a data-driven technology proposition within financial services.

As the organisation develops its product and commercial capability, it is looking for a hands-on Fractional Data Analyst to help turn growing volumes of business and product data into meaningful analysis, insight and decision support.

This is an early-stage environment.

You will not be joining a large established Data function with perfectly structured datasets, mature reporting infrastructure and predefined analytical processes.

The successful candidate will therefore need to be comfortable working with ambiguity, identifying data-quality issues and helping establish analytical processes as the organisation develops.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application – Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter. Within your cover letter, you must answer each of the mandatory qualifying questions below.

  1. How many years of professional Data Analyst or equivalent analytical experience do you have, and in what environments?
  2. What is your level of SQL proficiency? Please provide an example of a complex analysis or data problem you have personally solved using SQL.
  3. What experience do you have cleaning, validating and analysing incomplete or inconsistent datasets?
  4. Which data-visualisation and business-intelligence tools have you used professionally? Please explain your level of hands-on experience with each.
  5. Please provide an example where analysis you personally conducted materially influenced a product, commercial, credit, risk or operational decision.
  6. What experience do you have using Python or other analytical/programming tools? Please describe how you have used them rather than simply listing the technology.
  7. Do you have experience analysing financial-services, FinTech, payments, lending, credit, business or other complex datasets? Please explain.
  8. What experience do you have working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand a business question and translate it into useful analysis?
  9. This opportunity requires approximately 6–8 hours per week. Can you consistently commit to this level of involvement alongside your other professional commitments?

These questions are mandatory and form part of our initial assessment process. Applications that do not provide a clear answer to every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not be considered further in the recruitment process.

What You'll Be Doing

You will provide hands-on analytical support across the developing organisation, including:

  • Analysing business, product and operational datasets
  • Writing and maintaining SQL queries
  • Cleaning and validating data
  • Identifying data-quality issues
  • Exploring patterns, trends and anomalies
  • Developing dashboards and reports
  • Translating business questions into analytical approaches
  • Presenting findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Supporting Product, Risk and commercial decision-making
  • Helping establish appropriate metrics and KPIs
  • Supporting data-driven experimentation and evaluation
  • Documenting analytical methodologies where appropriate
  • Helping improve the consistency and usability of data as the company develops

What We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Professional Data Analyst or equivalent experience
  • Strong practical SQL capability
  • Experience manipulating imperfect real-world datasets
  • Strong analytical reasoning
  • Experience with data visualisation / BI tools
  • Some practical Python or comparable analytical-programming capability
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to identify questionable data rather than blindly report it
  • Ability to explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently
  • Comfort operating within an early-stage environment where not everything has already been defined

Experience within FinTech, financial services, credit, payments, lending, banking or other data-rich regulated environments would be particularly valuable.

We will consider candidates from adjacent industries where they can demonstrate sufficiently strong analytical capability.

Engagement Structure

This is a flexible, fractional engagement of approximately 6–8 hours per week within an early-stage FinTech venture.

It is designed for someone comfortable contributing specialist analytical capability alongside other compatible professional commitments and with a structure centred on longer-term participation in company growth rather than a conventional package at this stage.

Full details of the participation structure will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

For additional information, visit .

Job Summary

As Head of Partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing Ironmark’s partnership strategy. You will identify and engage potential partners, negotiate collaboration terms, and manage ongoing relationships to drive partner sourced, partner influenced revenue and shared success. Your ability to build strong relationships, think strategically, and align partnerships with Ironmark’s goals will be instrumental in our continued growth.

Performance & Market Engagement

  • Partner-influenced revenue

  • Strong leadership skills and ability to work both autonomously and as a team player.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to identify growth opportunities and align partnerships with business objectives.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for innovation and building mutually beneficial relationships.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess partnership performance and provide data-driven insights.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Problem solving disposition, curious by nature, with a constant desire to improve and achieve.
  • Ability to scope business requirements and document/communicate requirements.
  • Solid understanding of sales cycles and pipeline management.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines for fast execution.
  • Strong attention to detail and vigorous follow-up capabilities.
  • Must be able and willing to travel for partner meetings, conferences, and industry events, up to 30% of the time.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum Experience: Proven experience in partnership management, business development, or related roles.
  • Experience managing partnership programs including affinity, co-sell, resell and referral relationships.
  • Track record of achieving and/or exceeding strategic partnership/partner relations objectives.
  • Business development experience with a strong hunter/prospecting mentality.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and CRM (salesforce.com/HubSpot) required.

Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.

Section 1: Position Summary

The Director of Government Savings Operations is responsible for the strategic oversight, leadership, and optimization of processing functions within Government Savings. This role leads a large organization of associates, team leads, and managers while also providing oversight and direction to a global operations team operating in a dotted-line reporting structure. The Director is accountable for driving operational excellence through process improvement, standardization, and scalable solutions across all teams.

This leader plays a critical role in shaping and executing the operational strategy by leveraging technology, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), to improve efficiency, accuracy, and client experience. A strong understanding of transfer agency systems and operational workflows is essential to inform automation opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

The role requires end-to-end accountability for key performance indicators (KPIs), including budget adherence, SLA performance, quality, productivity, and escalation management. The Director must ensure consistent execution of policies, procedures, and controls while maintaining agility to respond to changing volumes, peak seasons, and evolving client needs. Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and cross-functional collaboration are essential to achieving business objectives and delivering high-quality service to partners and clients.

Proactively adopt, protect and boldly embrace emerging technologies (AI, automation, etc.), platforms, and evolving practices that accelerate transformational growth and advance Ascensus’ mission and client commitments.

RN Crisis Care Triage

Sedgwick is currently seeking Triage Nurses to join our Crisis Care team. This is a remote part-time position working 32-hours per week. The team operates 24/7, with the greatest staffing needs during afternoon, evening hours, overnight and weekends.

As a nurse at Sedgwick, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career while advocating for patients in a nontraditional clinical setting.

  • Apply your medical/clinical or rehabilitation knowledge and experience to assist in the management of complex medical conditions, treatment planning and recovery from illness or injury.

  • Work in the best of both worlds - a rewarding career making an impact on the health and lives of others, and a remote work environment.

  • Enjoy flexibility in your career path while advocating for the most effective and efficient medical treatment for injured employees in a non-traditional setting.

  • Enable our Caring counts® mission supporting injured employees from some of the world’s best brands and organizations.

  • Be a part of a rapidly growing, industry-leading global company known for its excellence and customer service.

  • Celebrate your career achievements and each other through professional development opportunities, continuing education credits, team building initiatives and more.

  • Access diverse and comprehensive benefits to take care of your mental, physical, financial and professional needs.

PRIMARY PURPOSE: Triages incoming catastrophic injury referral calls from clients; gathers vital case details, obtains and provides medical status updates to the customer, and assigns a Field Case Manager (FCM) for onsite visits as appropriate. Ensures that client service guidelines are followed and communicated to the appropriate parties and promotes quality cost-effective outcomes through communication and available resources.

ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE? We are looking for enthusiastic candidates who thrive in a collaborative environment, who are driven to deliver great work.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES MAY INCLUDE:

  • Provides professional and timely responses to incoming catastrophic referral calls from clients, applying all phases of the nursing process, i.e. assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation when triaging calls.

  • Triages the catastrophic referral utilizing critical reasoning, the department triage log, and associated workflow; utilizes customer specific guidelines to obtain pertinent data.

  • Identifies life-threatening emergencies and recommends appropriate interventions.

  • Assigns appropriate Field Case Manager assignment and facilitates initial onsite hospital visit for the claim.

  • Maintains communication with the customer, Client Service Director, and Claims Examiner providing timely updates on changes in injured worker status and FCM estimated time of arrival.

  • Communicates phone advice in a calm manner, ensuring it is properly received and understood.
