raw.excerpt: Position OverviewPower your future with Qualus as a Senior Project Manager on our Engineering team.
raw.description:
Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus as a Senior Project Manager on our Engineering team. The Senior Project Manager at Qualus is responsible for leading and managing advisory, engineering, engineer-procure (EP), and engineer-procure-construct (EPC) projects with a focus on high-voltage electrical substations, transmission lines, telecommunications, renewable energy (solar, geothermal, wind), electric utilities and large load industrial projects. This includes managing all activities related to project scope, schedule, cost/budget, quality, communications, resources, procurement, and risk elements to optimize client service, quality and financial performance on large, complex and challenging projects. This role also involves cross-disciplinary coordination, client relationship management, and mentoring junior staff. Occasional travel, including overnight stays, is required.

Responsibilities

  • The Senior Project Manager will lead and manage complex engineering projects across substation design, transmission, telecommunications, renewable energy interconnections, electric utilities and large load industrial facilities.
  • Work with project teams including engineers, designers, and subcontractors in the coordination of project documents and drawings, ensuring schedules are met.
  • Manage project scope, budget, scheduling, and change control throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support procurement and construction activities, including managing site construction managers and procurement teams.
  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with our external business partners.
  • Support proposal development including scope definition, cost estimating, schedule creation, and vendor quote evaluation.
  • Coordinate overall conceptual design plans in the initial development phase of large load, renewable energy and battery storage projects specific to utility interconnections and/or non-grid connections.
  • Coordinate environmental permitting and land rights as needed with clients, agencies and staff.
  • Assist clients with competitive bidding processes for steel structures, long lead electrical equipment and substation construction activities.
  • Mentor less experienced staff on a wide range of technical and project management best practices and competencies.
  • Participate in internal process improvements and help to develop Qualus's project control systems and standards.
  • Work with large load developers, renewable energy developers and other clients with support specific to schedules and cost estimates.
  • Prepare and maintain project schedules as needed and coordinate with team members and clients on schedule impacts.
  • Track budgets, prepare regular project status reports, and conduct team/client meetings.
  • Generally, keep management appraised of project status and report as needed to clients, agencies, and team members. This often includes facilitating monthly or bi-weekly team meetings and issuing meeting notes
  • Occasional travel (1–2 times per month) with overnight stays required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • The Senior Project Manager is expected to bring an advanced level to knowledge of everything involved to complete a project design from start to finish.
  • Ideal candidates will have a Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in Engineering, Electrical or Civil Engineering is preferred.
  • Minimum of 7–10 years of experience in utility-scale electrical projects, including substation and transmission design or related technical area.
  • Strong understanding of electrical power systems, utility interconnection requirements, renewable energy, and large load industrial infrastructure.
  • Strong competence in applying theories and principals involved in project management
  • Strong work ethic, common sense approach, and high attention to detail.
  • Customer-focused with the ability to work under pressure and manage shifting priorities.
  • Excellent computer skills, Microsoft Office, and proficient with scheduling (MS Project or Primavera P6 preferred)
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and demands
  • Must pass a pre-employment drug screening and background check satisfactory to Qualus.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus benefits offered include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays, for those who qualify.

The final salary awarded for this role may vary from the above range based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The salary range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

raw.description:
Technicien(ne) bilingue de soutien technique VoIP – Niveau 1 (français/anglais)

À propos de Cloudli

Cloudli Communications est un fournisseur de premier plan de solutions de communications infonuagiques et de VoIP. Nous aidons les entreprises à rester connectées grâce à des services de communication fiables, flexibles et novateurs.
Nous nous engageons à offrir une excellente expérience client en combinant des technologies de communication modernes à un soutien compétent et réactif. Chez Cloudli, nos équipes travaillent en collaboration afin de résoudre les problèmes, de soutenir nos clients et partenaires et d’améliorer continuellement nos services ainsi que l’expérience que nous offrons.

Description du poste

Le ou la technicien(ne) bilingue de soutien technique VoIP de niveau 1 fournit un soutien technique de première ligne aux clients, en français et en anglais. La personne titulaire du poste est responsable du dépannage des problèmes courants liés à la VoIP, aux téléphones et à la connectivité, de la documentation des interactions avec les clients ainsi que de la résolution des demandes de manière rapide et professionnelle.
Le ou la technicien(ne) suivra les procédures de dépannage établies, assurera une documentation claire et complète des billets de soutien et transmettra les problèmes plus complexes au soutien de niveau 2 lorsque nécessaire.
La personne idéale est orientée vers le service à la clientèle, possède de bonnes aptitudes techniques et s’engage à offrir une expérience de soutien positive.

Exigences du poste

Formation et expérience

  • Au moins un an d’expérience en soutien technique, centre d’assistance, service à la clientèle ou soutien VoIP, de préférence
  • Expérience dans un environnement de soutien dynamique et axé sur le service à la clientèle
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, requise
  • Capacité à fournir un soutien technique professionnel aux clients en français et en anglais

Compétences requises

  • Compréhension de base des technologies et services VoIP
  • Compréhension de base des protocoles SIP et RTP
  • Connaissance des concepts de réseautique IP, notamment l’adressage IP, la connectivité, les routeurs, les pare-feu et le dépannage réseau de base
  • Capacité à effectuer du dépannage de niveau 1 pour les problèmes VoIP courants, notamment :
    • Téléphones qui ne s’enregistrent pas ou qui indiquent une absence de service
    • Problèmes liés aux appels entrants et sortants
    • Problèmes de base liés à l’acheminement des appels
    • Audio unidirectionnel ou absence d’audio
    • Problèmes de qualité des appels, de latence, de gigue et de perte de paquets
    • Problèmes liés à la messagerie vocale et aux fonctionnalités de base
    • Problèmes de connectivité des téléphones IP et autres appareils
  • Capacité à suivre les procédures de dépannage et la documentation de soutien établies
  • Expérience avec les systèmes de gestion de billets et les outils de dépannage à distance
  • Capacité à maintenir une documentation claire et précise des étapes de dépannage, des interactions avec les clients et des solutions apportées
  • Capacité à reconnaître les problèmes nécessitant une escalade et à fournir au soutien de niveau 2 tous les détails pertinents concernant les étapes de dépannage effectuées
  • Capacité à traiter les demandes des clients de manière rapide et professionnelle

Compétences essentielles

  • Excellentes aptitudes en service à la clientèle et en communication
  • Solides compétences en dépannage et en résolution de problèmes
  • Capacité à expliquer clairement des renseignements techniques à une clientèle non technique
  • Capacité à demeurer professionnel(le) lors d’interactions avec des clients frustrés
  • Capacité à suivre les processus et procédures établis
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en collaborant avec les autres membres de l’équipe de soutien
  • Souci du détail et excellentes habitudes en matière de documentation et de gestion des billets
  • Volonté d’apprendre et de développer ses connaissances techniques en VoIP et en réseautique
  • Sens aigu des responsabilités et capacité à assurer un suivi rigoureux des demandes clients assignées

Atouts

  • Expérience préalable en soutien de services VoIP ou de communications unifiées
  • Expérience avec les téléphones IP, les adaptateurs téléphoniques analogiques (ATA) ou d’autres appareils VoIP similaires
  • Connaissance des protocoles SIP et RTP ainsi que des flux d’appels VoIP de base
  • Expérience avec Zendesk, Jira Service Management ou des plateformes similaires de gestion de billets
  • Connaissance du provisionnement et du dépannage à distance des appareils
  • Compréhension de base des technologies NAT, des pare-feu, de DHCP, de DNS et de la connectivité réseau


VoIP Tier 1 Bilingual Technical Support – French/English

About Cloudli
Cloudli Communications is a leading provider of cloud-based communications and VoIP solutions, helping businesses stay connected through reliable, flexible, and innovative communication services. We are committed to delivering a strong customer experience by combining modern communications technology with knowledgeable and responsive support. At Cloudli, our teams work collaboratively to solve problems, support our customers and partners, and continuously improve the services and experiences we provide.

Job Description
The VoIP Tier 1 Bilingual Technical Support Technician provides frontline technical support to customers in both French and English. This role is responsible for troubleshooting common VoIP, phone, and connectivity issues, documenting customer interactions, and resolving requests in a timely and professional manner.
The technician will follow established troubleshooting procedures, maintain clear ticket documentation, and escalate more complex issues to Tier 2 when necessary. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically capable, and committed to providing a positive support experience.

Job Requirements

Education & Experience
  • 1+ year of experience in technical support, help desk, customer support, or VoIP support preferred
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, customer-focused support environment
  • Fluency in both French and English, written and verbal, required
  • Ability to provide professional technical support to customers in both French and English
Required Skills
  • Basic understanding of VoIP technologies and services
  • Basic understanding of SIP and RTP
  • Familiarity with IP networking concepts, including IP addressing, connectivity, routers, firewalls, and basic network troubleshooting
  • Ability to perform Tier 1 troubleshooting for common VoIP issues, including:
    • Phones not registering or showing no service
    • Inbound and outbound calling issues
    • Basic call routing issues
    • One-way or no audio
    • Call quality, latency, jitter, and packet loss
    • Voicemail and basic feature issues
    • IP phone and device connectivity issues
  • Ability to follow established troubleshooting procedures and support documentation
  • Experience using ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation of troubleshooting steps, customer interactions, and resolutions
  • Recognize issues requiring escalation and provide complete troubleshooting details to Tier 2
  • Resolve customer requests in a timely and professional manner
Core Competencies
  • Strong customer service and communication skills
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical customers
  • Ability to remain professional when working with frustrated customers
  • Ability to follow established processes and procedures
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with other support team members
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and ticket-management habits
  • Willingness to learn and develop technical VoIP and networking skills
  • Strong ownership and follow-through on assigned customer requests
Nice to Have
  • Previous experience supporting VoIP or Unified Communications services
  • Experience supporting IP phones, ATAs, or similar VoIP devices
  • Familiarity with SIP, RTP, and basic VoIP call flows
  • Experience with Zendesk, Jira Service Management, or similar ticketing platforms
  • Familiarity with remote device provisioning and troubleshooting
  • Basic understanding of NAT, firewalls, DHCP, DNS, and network connectivity

raw.description:
We are seeking a dynamic individual to join the Economic Research team at Signal49 Research.

Signal49 Research is the nation’s largest independent applied research organization offering unbiased, evidence-based information and analysis to both industry, NGOs and federal/provincial governments. We have one of the country’s largest private economic analysis and forecasting teams and are widely recognized for expert economic forecasting, modeling, and leading analysis. Signal49 Research also undertakes research to address the most pressing issues in Innovation and Technology, Human Capital, Sustainability, Immigration, Indigenous and Northern Communities, Education and Skills, and Health. Our social science research provides actionable pathways to solutions. Simply put, we deliver insights that help Canada’s leaders cut through the noise and make informed decisions. To learn more about Signal49 Research and our history, check out our website:

Our Ideal Candidate is…passionate about economics and economic policy. You should have a solid understanding of applied econometrics, data analysis tools and methods, and advanced communication skills. Our ideal Economist candidate has a master’s degree in economics, economic policy or similar field as well as two years’ work experience in a related role. Further, you should display mature judgment, be committed to high quality work, and be able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. This role requires intellectual curiosity, passion and commitment to an organization that values quality, creativity and thought leadership.

We are a virtual organization and as a remote worker you must be comfortable and able to work 100 per cent of the time from a home office in Canada. To be successful as a remote worker you need to have a self-starter attitude, possess strong organizational and time management skills and be a proactive communicator. Having a home office environment that provides for a productive, professional, and safe work environment during regular working/business hours is a requirement of this role. This includes internet service with a reliable connection.

About the Role

  • Undertake economic and data analyses independently to produce high-quality work that is accurate, complete, and adheres to the prescribed methodology.
  • Lead the writing of clear, impactful reports leveraging a variety of tools, including data visualizations.
  • Support the development and customization of macroeconomic forecast models.
  • Support research projects of varying complexity utilizing your knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methods.
  • Filter large amounts of research and stay current on issues affecting assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Contribute to large research projects as part of a team of economists and other social science researchers.
  • Support constructive and respectful client engagements by preparing meeting materials, contributing to methodological and planning discussions.
  • Prioritize competing tasks and work effectively to meet deadlines.
  • Consistently demonstrate professional values in all aspects of work and interactions with colleagues and clients.
  • Contribute, as needed, to the development of research project proposals for internal and external audiences.
  • Commitment to producing high-quality work and demonstrating professional values in all aspects of work and interactions with colleagues and customers.

About You

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Two years of professional experience in a related role as an economist or analyst.
  • Masters in economics, economic policy, data science or similar field of study.
  • Knowledge of and experience in the applications of statistics, econometric modeling, regression analysis, forecasting techniques, and statistical software packages.
  • Experience working with R, Python and/or EViews.
  • Strong research skills and a demonstrated proficiency in synthesizing complex concepts and information from a variety of sources.
  • Advanced communication skills in English (both oral and written).
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with all levels of internal and external contacts and customers.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in a Microsoft Office environment.
  • Proficiency in French is an asset.
  • Having a home office environment that provides for a productive, professional, and safe work environment during regular working/business hours is a requirement of this role. This includes internet service with a reliable connection.

Benefits

At Signal49 Research, we believe that putting People First is key to our success and attracting the best people. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive and we are proud to offer a package that includes:

  • Virtual First – work from home anywhere across Canada.
  • A workplace where your hard work is not just valued, but actively celebrated. We take pride in our commitment to recognizing and rewarding the exceptional talent that drives our success through our Recognition programs.
  • Employee Family Assistance Program (EFAP): We understand that life can be unpredictable and challenging and EFAP supports you and your family during difficult times.
  • Work/Life Balance: We offer the option of compressed workweeks with Friday afternoon closures.
  • A modern, defined benefit (DB) pension plan: We care about your future and offer an optional pension plan with a 5% match eligibility from Day One

The hiring zone for this position is $67,320-$79,200 annually for candidates from any Canadian province or territory. Salaries are based upon candidate experience, qualifications, specific skillsets, as well as market and business considerations. The full compensation band for this position ranges from $67,320-$91,080. The recruiter can share more information about compensation for the position during the hiring process. About Anaconda

Be at the center of AI

Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. With 21 billion downloads and growing, Anaconda has established itself as the gold standard for Python, data science, and AI and the enterprise-ready solution of choice for AI innovation. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at .

Summary:

Anaconda's Design organization now owns our design system end to end, from Figma libraries and design tokens through to the code components engineers ship. We're mid-flight on a migration of our component architecture to a modern stack, converging two product surfaces into one platform, and defining how a design practice works in an agentic AI world.

As our Principal Product Designer, you'll own the design system as a product: its architecture, its governance, and its evolution across converging surfaces. You'll partner directly with engineering to land the migration, then build the AI-forward design practice on top of it: the patterns, tooling, and workflows for designing agentic product experiences. This is a senior IC role reporting to the VP of Design, operating with wide autonomy in a deliberately flat, senior team.


What You'll Do:
  • Own the design system end to end: design tokens, component libraries, documentation, and the code components engineers consume, across two converging product surfaces.
  • Lead the migration of our component architecture to a modern stack (shadcn/ui, Storybook), partnering with engineering to re-baseline scope and ship a complete, production-quality tranche.
  • Define the governance that outlives any individual: versioning, contribution model, release process, and explicit exit criteria for design handoff that both design and engineering sign.
  • Establish Anaconda's AI-forward design practice: patterns, guidelines, and tooling for agentic product surfaces, and ship the first product experiences that use them.
  • Work in design and code: prototype in the production stack and review component implementations.
  • Raise the bar across a senior design team through influence: critique, pairing, and visible craft.
  • Use AI-assisted tools, including Claude Code, reviewing and validating AI generated output before it ships.
Your Impact Will Be Measured Through:
  • Completion and adoption of the component architecture migration across both product surfaces.
  • Reduction in design-to-engineering handoff time and rework, measured against explicit exit criteria.
  • Cross-team adoption of design system governance: versioned releases, contribution model, and shared definition of done.
  • AI-forward design patterns shipped in production surfaces and reused across the platform.
What You Need:
  • 12+ years of product design experience, including several years owning a design system at scale, tokens, component architecture, and governance, not only consumption.
  • Engineering fluency: comfortable working in TypeScript/React component codebases and Storybook, and applied in technical architecture discussions.
  • Proven experience leading a design system migration or re-platform in a production environment, including scoping what ships and what parks.
  • Demonstrated experience designing AI-driven or agentic product experiences.
  • Experience using AI assisted tools, such as Claude Code, as part of a professional workflow, including reviewing and validating AI generated output before it ships.
  • A track record of leading through influence in flat or ambiguous structures, defining the operating model rather than executing within one.
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • You've taken a design system through a framework migration at enterprise scale and can walk us through what you kept, cut, and parked — and why.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or component libraries, with public work you can show.
  • Experience designing for developer tools, data science, or technical audiences.
  • You've built design tooling or automation — internal tools, Figma plugins, or AI-assisted design workflows — that other designers adopted.
  • Experience working across converging or multi-product platforms where the design system was the connective tissue.
  • A clear point of view on how AI is reshaping design practice, shaped by hands-on work designing agentic experiences.
  • You embody our values: "Curious by Default", "Build Together", "Own It", and "Lead with Guts and Heart", and our behaviors: Clarity, Care and Candor.
  • You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish.
Why You'll Like Working Here:
  • You'll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded
  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise.
  • You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor.
  • You'll be supported by a culture that puts employees first - with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your wellbeing and growth.

The application deadline for this role is 11/02/2026;applicants will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.

The base salary range for this role is $146,500 - $216,000, along with annual bonus potential, equity participation, and benefits.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by various factors, including work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will provide more specific details on the salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Flexible Vacation Policy

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend
  • Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

About Command|Link

Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions,helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command|Link was recognized as the SD-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

Learn more about us here!

This is a 100% remote opportunity.

About your new role:

The Managed Services Network Engineer is a critical role responsible for supporting and delivering superior service to ISP/MSP business customers. You will play a key part in managing and troubleshooting SDWAN networks (with an emphasis on Versa Networks), business data circuits, VoIP services, VPNs, Managed Routers, Firewalls, and other custom-managed services.

No travel to customer locations is required.

Preferred Shift: Wednesday - Sunday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm Eastern US Time

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide end-to-end support for customers with a focus on SDWAN (preferably Versa Networks), Internet, and related services.
  • Troubleshoot and configure basic LAN setups (Routers, Firewalls) and Microsoft operating systems.
  • Support the provisioning and onboarding of new customers for managed services.
  • Collaborate with vendors to resolve support issues and ensure smooth service delivery.
  • Own support issues from start to resolution, ensuring customer satisfaction with clear communication and expert problem-solving.
  • Maintain excellent customer relationships by delivering outstanding support and going the extra mile.
  • Mentor and train fellow engineers on complex technical issues and solutions.

What you'll need for success:

  • High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in a fast-paced technical environment, with demonstrated expertise in SDWAN, particularly Versa Networks.
  • CCNA and CCNP certification is highly desirable
  • Command line experience with networking tools (e.g., Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper).
  • Strong firewall configuration experience (e.g., Fortinet).
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience with BGP, OSPF, and VRRP.
  • Practical knowledge of basic routers, firewalls, and NAT (Network Address Translation).
  • Experience with COS/QOS and network design principles.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 compliance and processes.

Why you'll love life at Command|Link

Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

  • Room to grow at a high-growth company
  • An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
  • Your work will have a tangible impact
  • Flexible time off
  • Fun events at cool locations
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

At CommandLink, we’re committed to creating a fair, consistent, and efficient hiring experience. As part of our process, we use AI-assisted tools to help review and analyze applications. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.

AI tools are used only to assist in the evaluation process — they do not make final hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting or hiring team before any decisions are made.

Who We Are

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform coupled with an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 500 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce at our company. At Cobalt we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations in order to continue to nurture our unique rich diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

Description

All organizations need security testing for their software and we are building the world’s largest and smartest pentest management platform to help solve this challenge at scale.

As a Contract Senior Staff Product Manager, you will drive the definition, delivery, and adoption of new product features and ecosystem integrations. You will be responsible for taking the lead of our next gen deliverables, from user discovery and roadmap prioritization to go-to-market execution - ensuring that our platform evolves to solve the most pressing challenges in the security workflow.

This is a full-time contractor position providing hourly coverage from October through the end of February. In this role, you will merge attention to detail with the ability to understand and align business objectives, while working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to drive customer insights and inputs directly into the development process. You will work closely with our other Customer Experience and Pentester Experience teams.

What You Would Do

As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include:

  • Rapidly acquire new technical knowledge while maintaining meticulous attention to detail. Champion the strategic product direction across the organization, ensuring internal and external synchronization while serving as a subject matter expert on industry developments and defensive security operations.
  • Represent our customers. Work with Product Design, Product Marketing, Sales and Customer Success teams to bring the customer’s voice into the development process.
  • Manage the platform next-gent feature deliverables . Make tough tactical prioritization decisions while enabling the company to think long-term.
  • Collaborate across teams. We win or lose as a team. Product managers are a critical role in creating alignment between engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Have familiarity with information security, security operations, vulnerability disclosure, vulnerability management and other security domain areas.
  • Become an expert in pentesting best practices. You are ready to discuss and demonstrate product details with developers, product designers, security operations, pentesters, customers and sales prospects.
  • Measure success. Own the measures used to define success for your product. Success measures must be defined at the inception of a product and tracked throughout its lifecycle. Make measures visible to all stakeholders and interpret them into actionable conclusions and new hypotheses.
  • Lead Go-to-Market (GTM) Readiness: Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to orchestrate successful feature launches. Develop launch strategies, create internal training materials, and support the creation of customer-facing collateral to ensure seamless adoption.
  • Maintain technical fluency in the operational workflows of modern cybersecurity tools, including vulnerability management or offensive security platforms. Evaluate how these tools function within a customer’s security environment to inform product development.

You Must Have

  • 8+ years experience in Product Management and 3+ years experience in cybersecurity tools (vulnerability management or offensive security platforms), with a demonstrated ability to discover new opportunities and then define and deliver products. Experience in fast-growing software companies is a plus.
  • Strong technical skills - you can work alongside customers to help debug and improve our integration offerings.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder empathy. You must not only be the voice of the customer but at various times the voice of marketing, finance, engineering, sales and customer success. You must be able to channel many points of view.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You’re great at explaining highly technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences, with a talent for building empathy for user problems.
  • Strong analytical capabilities is a plus.
  • Strong bias for action, creative thinking, innovation and data-driven product decision-making.
  • A can-do attitude and ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience with agile software development.
  • Experience working with global team members (This team is a global team).
  • Hands-on experience with core cybersecurity tooling (e.g., DAST/SAST scanners, vulnerability management systems, or pentest workflow platforms). Articulate how security teams utilize these tools to identify, prioritize, and remediate risk, understanding the "why" behind the tooling workflow beyond simple API integrations.
  • Strong technical and product communication skills: Ability to translate complex security concepts into clear documentation, user guides, and release notes tailored to both technical developers and business stakeholders.
  • Full-time availability for the duration of the contract. You must be able to commit to full-time hourly coverage from October through the end of February, with no planned extended absences or vacations during the contract period (excluding recognized company holiday’s).

Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only)

Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The hourly range for this role is $84 - $106. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities.

Cobalt (the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer, and we want the best available persons for every job. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company.

Cobalt is an E-Verify employer. E-Verify is an Internet-based system operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA). It allows participating employers to electronically verify the employment eligibility of their newly hired employees in the United States.

Senior Content Writer, Adoptions and Proposals

They lead the strategy, development, and maintenance of i-Ready content in the proposal content database, while maintaining a strong working knowledge of Curriculum Associates’ broader product portfolio to ensure that all products and services can be represented with clear, compelling, and differentiated messaging that aligns with company strategy. Own major initiatives for content development and maintenance

Lead and contribute to complex, program‑specific proposals and rubrics

raw.excerpt: About Us Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish.
raw.description:
About Us

Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish. We began as a digital mortgage broker and became Canada's leading direct-to-consumer online lending platform. Through Nesto Cloud, our B2B, cloud-native, end-to-end mortgage technology platform, we empower financial institutions, credit unions, and commercial real estate lenders with intelligent automation, real-time compliance, and seamless integrations across the full lending lifecycle. Together with CMLS Financial, we form the Nesto Group: more than $73 billion CAD in residential and commercial mortgages under management, 1,300+ team members, 12 offices across Canada.

Our Track Record

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 – 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year – 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025

Why Join Us

The mortgage industry runs on legacy systems, slow processes, and information nobody can see. We are changing that by building better technology. nesto is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and curious minds – people who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together. This is the place for you if you trust your skills and want to build technology that reshapes an entire industry. An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients. We also do not think building with AI belongs to engineers. Every function here is expected to automate its own repetitive work, and you will have support to do it.

Work Location and Time Zone

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. We strongly prefer candidates who can work Eastern Time hours. If you are based elsewhere in Canada and have worked Eastern hours before, we still want to hear from you.

Why This Role Exists

We're delivering major platform programs for our large enterprise partners. This role is focused on building automation coverage for these initiatives, shaping end-to-end quality as the programs scale.

We already have a strong automation suite and deep in-house expertise at the staff level. This is not a rebuild from zero. It's about taking what works, adapting it to a platform being reshaped for these programs, and wiring it into CI/CD so quality keeps pace with delivery speed. We move fast and iterate, but we don't ship manual workarounds – we invest in repeatable, scalable structure.

You'd be the automation specialist within our delivery team, working closely with our staff automation developers as expert sounding boards, setting the approach and advising us on how this should be done. You can expect roughly a 80/20 split between hands-on coding and collaboration, depending on the project stage.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 90 days, a working test automation framework is running, with 60–80% of critical test scenarios automated, running, and actively relied on by the team.
  • Within six months, automation runs in the CI/CD pipeline on pull requests, mirroring what exists for our core platform.
  • You've adapted and extended the existing automation framework rather than rebuilding from scratch – leveraging the suite and expertise already in place.
  • You make sure quality is understood beyond sprint-by-sprint testing, with a focus on ensuring all the pieces work together end to end.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable automated test suites in Playwright, using design patterns that keep them maintainable over time.
  • Partner with architects, developers, product managers, and our Staff QA Automation Developers across the SDLC – to clarify requirements and define clear acceptance criteria early, and to raise QA practices across the organization.
  • Drive quality across UI and API testing, using monitoring signals, incident reviews, and customer feedback to find improvements.
  • Work with Delivery leadership, stakeholders, and partners to prioritize automation coverage.
  • Integrate automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline so coverage runs continuously.
  • Work with product managers to define comprehensive test plans from product and design specifications (URDs, PRDs, HLDs).
  • Play a key role in supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for key projects, for example when we integrate new partners or clients.
  • Leverage AI to speed up how you build and maintain automated tests, then share what works with the team.
  • Own quality beyond test execution – improve processes, documentation, and team workflows, and standardize what works into repeatable practices.
  • Review and run manual test cases in our test management tooling, validate features against test plans, and fold the right scenarios into the automated regression suite.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of QA experience testing SaaS or cloud applications, with a deep understanding of the full SDLC and how Quality Engineering fits into development.
  • 2+ years of hands-on test automation framework experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar, including authoring and maintaining end-to-end (E2E) test suites.
  • A strong background in TypeScript and/or Go is required, and experience with MySQL or similar relational databases is a plus.
  • An automation-first track record: automated coverage over manual-only QA, with reliability built into the CI/CD pipeline rather than bolted on.
  • Full-stack testing across UI and API layers, including API validation with tools like Postman.
  • Test architecture and scalable design expertise, using patterns such as Page Object Model, data factories, and separation of concerns.
  • Agile fluency, comfort with rapid release cycles, and familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps.
  • Initiative and a point of view. You arrive with a plan rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Nice-to-Have

  • Hands-on AI initiative: you have built agents or applications that made testing meaningfully faster
  • You turn requirements into genuinely useful test coverage, not checkbox test cases
  • Experience with MySQL or similar relational databases
  • Familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps
  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, banking, insurance, or other financial services environments

This Role Might Fit You If

  • You have stood up automation from nothing on a program already in flight, and found that energizing rather than daunting
  • You would rather adapt and evolve a working system than rebuild it to your own taste
  • You are comfortable telling leadership "here is what we should do and here is how" early on, not a year in
  • You enjoy being in the room with business and delivery people, not only engineers, and can explain why a test gap matters in business terms
  • You want to shape quality strategy, not only write test code

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a heads-down coding role. If you want to stay out of product and business conversations, this will frustrate you.
  • This is not a role focused mainly on executing manual test cases.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers a reactive, waterfall approach and waits for development to finish before getting involved.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers to work in isolation and doesn't want to improve broader team workflows, documentation, or quality processes.
  • This is not a role for someone who isn't ready to bring AI tools into their daily work.


Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): An intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (45 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Take-Home Assignment: A chance to showcase your skills through a practical exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.


What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Diversity and Inclusion
At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

KI nur mit höchster Sensibilität für Kundendaten: Datenschutz steht über jedem Effizienzgewinn. KI ausschließlich auf vertraglich abgesicherten, datenschutzkonformen Plattformen, minimierte und anonymisierte Daten, niemals Kundendaten im Modelltraining. Diesen Umgang – und die Bereitschaft,
unsere Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich mit KI weiterzuentwickeln – erwarten wir von allen Berater:innen.

Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle ist Detection Engineering: SIEM- und XDR-Plattformen, Log-Qualität, Detectionas-Code und Automatisierung – sicher in KQL, Sigma und MITRE ATT&CK.

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn:

  • du ein attraktives Fixgehalt plus überdurchschnittliche Gewinnbeteiligung willst.
  • du ortsunabhängig an hochrelevanten Projekten in Security Operations und KI-Sicherheit arbeiten willst.
  • du KI als Hebel siehst und Sicherheitsberatung neu denken willst – ohne Kompromisse beim Datenschutz.
  • du deine Expertise in SOC-Plattformen, Detection Engineering und Automatisierung ausbauen willst.

Aufgaben

  • Aufbau, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung von SOC-Plattformen (SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR)
  • Onboarding neuer Logquellen inklusive Parsing, Normalisierung und Sicherstellung der Datenqualität
  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von Detection-Regeln und Use Cases (Sigma, KQL, SPL) auf Basis von MITRE ATT&CK
  • Automatisierung von Analyse- und Response-Prozessen durch Playbooks und Skripting (Python, PowerShell)
  • Aufbau von Detection-as-Code-Pipelines inkl. Versionierung, Testing und CI/CD
  • Integration und Operationalisierung von Threat Intelligence
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Analyst:innen und Incident Respondern zur Reduktion von False Positives und Verbesserung der Detection-Qualität
  • Technische Unterstützung bei Sicherheitsvorfällen
  • Erstellung von Runbooks, Use-Case-Dokumentationen und technischen Konzepten
  • Einsatz KI-gestützter Werkzeuge für Log-Analyse, Regel- und Playbook-Entwürfe sowie Dokumentation – inklusive fachlicher Validierung und Freigabe der Ergebnisse

Qualifikation

  • Souveräner Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen im Beratungsalltag inkl. kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse
  • Ausgeprägtes Bewusstsein für Vertraulichkeit beim KI-Einsatz: Du weißt, welche Daten in welches System dürfen, und kennst die Risiken (Datenabfluss, Modelltraining, Prompt Injection)
  • Bereitschaft, Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich KI-basiert weiterzuentwickeln
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in IT-/Cyber-Security, davon mehrere Jahre in Architektur- oder Beratungsrollen
  • Breites Technologieverständnis über Netzwerk, Endpoint, Identity, Applikation und Cloud
  • Erfahrung mit Zero-Trust- und Segmentierungskonzepten sowie IAM/PAM (Entra ID, Active Directory)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, SABSA/TOGAF
  • Kenntnisse in Kryptografie, PKI und sicherem Applikationsdesign
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Von großem Vorteil:

  • Cloud-Architekten-Know-how: Design, Absicherung und Betrieb von Cloud- und Hybrid-Umgebungen (Azure, AWS, GCP), Cloud-native Security-Dienste, Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Erfahrung mit Prompt Engineering, KI-Agenten oder LLM-Integration in Workflows
  • Kenntnisse in KI-Governance (EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM)
  • Erfahrung in regulierten Umgebungen (KRITIS, Finanzsektor, Industrie/OT)

Zertifizierungen (nice to have):

OffSec (Hands-on & Offensive/Defensive Integration)

  • OSDA (Defense Analyst – SOC-200)
  • OSCP (PEN-200)
  • SANS / GIAC (Architektur & Tactical Detection)
  • GCDA (SANS SEC555)
  • GDSA (SANS SEC530)
  • GCIH (SANS SEC504)

Ergänzende Profil-Schärfung

  • SANS SEC586 (Blue Team Automation)
  • Microsoft SC-200

Benefits

  • Fixgehalt ab 80.000 € plus Gewinnbeteiligung bis zu 70.000 €
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Remote-Arbeit, 30 Tage Urlaub
  • IT-Equipment wie Apple MacBook
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Krankenversicherung, Shopping- und Mitarbeiterrabatte

Werde Teil von APT-ONE und mach Sicherheit zu deiner Mission

raw.excerpt: About RemoteRemote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease.
raw.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Manager, Payroll Operations, joining our Global Payroll Operations team. As a dynamic and energetic professional, the Manager, Payroll Operations will own the planning, and implementation of our Payroll chapter.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience in regional / global payroll operations specifically in Australia/ New Zealand
  • Understanding of global payroll best practices.
  • Experience in implementing payroll in multiple countries and in managing relationships with third party payroll services.
  • You are passionate about managing people, and you don't micromanage your reports.
  • Proficient in using software tools like SAP, Excel / Google Sheet.
  • An analytical mindset with great problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, international work environment with a passion for making an impact.
  • Is a productivity geek and will constantly think of ways to improve and speed up their work.
  • You understand the need and ideal to work largely asynchronously.
  • It's not required to have experience working remotely, but is considered a plus.
  • You write and speak fluent English.

Key Responsibilities

  • The Payroll team will report to you and you will provide them with guidance and mentorship.
    • The Manager, Payroll Operations will own the complete payroll function, ensuring payroll is processed on time, accurately, and in compliance with country specific government regulations.
  • Serve as a point of contact between internal and external stakeholders on all payroll related matters.
  • Lead the Payroll team, unblock and support them.
  • Be up to date with various international payroll laws / regulations.
  • Ensure compliance with all corporate and country-specific regulations, policies and procedures.
  • Manages existing relationships with payroll, accounting and payroll service providers.
  • Develop and implement best practices, key performance indicators and SLA metrics for the team.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Senior Manager, Payroll Operations
  • Team: Payroll Operations
  • Location: APAC
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with team members
  3. Interview with future manager
  4. Interview with Senior Director, Payroll Operations
  5. Bar Raiser Interview
  6. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$46,500—$104,650 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

raw.description:
Salary: R23 000 - R25 000 per month

Remote Recruitment is hiring a Reconciliations Clerk for a UK employer, fully remote from South Africa.

Role overview

You will match what the bank says against what the ledger says, and chase every difference until it is explained. It suits someone patient with detail who finds a clean, balanced reconciliation quietly satisfying.

You will work 09:00-17:00 UK time (11:00-19:00 SAST) from home, with equipment guidance, a proper induction and a manager who is contactable through the day. This is a permanent role, not a short contract.

Key responsibilities

  • Prepare daily and monthly bank reconciliations across multiple accounts
  • Investigate unmatched items and resolve them at source
  • Reconcile supplier and customer statements to the ledger
  • Post correcting journals with clear supporting notes
  • Flag recurring mismatches to the finance manager
  • Support month-end close with complete, tidy working papers

What you'll need

  • One or more years in a reconciliations, bookkeeping or finance clerk role
  • Experience with an accounting system such as Xero, Sage or QuickBooks
  • Confident with Excel lookups, filters and pivot tables
  • A methodical approach and the persistence to close out differences
  • Reliable home internet and a quiet space for UK-hours work

Nice to have

  • Exposure to multi-currency reconciliations
  • Experience with high-volume transaction environments
  • Familiarity with UK VAT basics

What's on offer

A permanent, fully remote role with structured handover, a supportive finance lead and clear month-end rhythms. Strong clerks progress into assistant accountant or finance administrator roles.

Remote Recruitment connects South African talent with UK employers. We reply to every application.

raw.description:
Arkestro's Predictive Procurement Platform applies AI, game theory, and behavioral science to enterprise negotiations. It moves teams away from reactive supplier bidding toward data-driven offers that reduce friction and help both buyers and suppliers reach better outcomes faster.

Arkestro helps procurement teams influence more enterprise spend and uncover savings that traditional sourcing approaches often leave behind by applying predictive intelligence to how sourcing events are designed and executed.

We’re a hyper-growth company looking for people who take ownership and are comfortable working through complexity. This is a tremendous opportunity if you want to do meaningful work and help shape how large enterprises run procurement… Arkestro is a place where you can have a big impact. See Arkestro in action at.

About This Role

We are looking for an AI Enablement Lead to lead AI adoption across every department at Arkestro. You will run the Arkestro AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) day to day, build with the dedicated department positions, coach a cross functional champions network, and fan every win out to everyone through the centralized system. Your charter is universal adoption with measured business value behind it. This is an influence role, not a control role: you build with the dedicated few, champions spread it, and everyone wins. Build once at the center; land it in every function.

Responsibilities

  • Own company wide AI adoption end to end: awareness, training, activation, and measured business value in every department
  • Run the AI Center of Excellence operating cadence: champions network, office hours, intake, prioritization, and the adoption scoreboard
  • Recruit, coach, and support at least one champion in every department, with protected time, and grow the bench behind them
  • Run cross functional AI pods: pair yourself or an AI proficient engineer with a department subject matter expert in a ten day sprint that ships a measured before and after result
  • Train through the layers: an AI fluency foundation for everyone, deeper training for dedicated positions and champions, so each layer lifts the next
  • Own the shared skills library and its distribution pipeline with Engineering: build once, publish once, and every channel receives it
  • Instrument adoption and outcomes: workflows converted, hours returned, and dollar impact; report monthly to executive staff
  • Manage the AI tooling portfolio and spend against budget caps; evaluate vendors and retire tools that do not earn their keep
  • Publish wins with numbers in shared channels; every showcased win recruits the next builder

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years in engineering, operations, or enablement roles:
    • including 2+ years leading adoption of a platform or practice across an organization
    • Including 1+ year in the last 2 years directly building, leading, influencing AI at the company level
  • Hands on builder: you script, call APIs, and wire automations yourself, and you have shipped AI workflows that other people now depend on
  • Proven training and facilitation skill: you have taught both technical and non technical audiences and can show the adoption curve that followed
  • Relentless resourcefulness with AI: where others clean one spreadsheet, you build the pipeline that cleans every tracker before the team wakes up
  • High empathy operator: you thrive dropping into any department, learning its workflow, and earning trust fast
  • Evidence of measured outcomes: you can point to before and after numbers you produced, not just activities you ran

Bonus Qualifications

  • Forward deployed engineering experience at an AI lab, consultancy, or product company
  • Procurement, supply chain, or B2B SaaS domain experience
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as ISO 42001, the NIST AI RMF, and SOC 2
  • Experience standing up a center of excellence or a champions program
Pay Range
$150,000—$185,000 USD

Arkestro is committed to providing our employees with a benefits package designed to give you the flexibility you need to ensure a healthy life/work balance. Arkestro offers our employees great benefits and perks, including, but not limited to:

  • Competitive salary and startup equity
  • Medical, Dental, Vision insurance premiums covered up to 100% (employee only)
  • 401K discretionary employer matching
  • Unlimited PTO
  • A remote-first team with regular opportunities to get together in person for team building, design sprints, and customer visits
  • Annual budget of $1,000 for learning and professional development
  • Diverse, inclusive, highly collaborative, and vibrant culture
Arkestro is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
Disclaimer

Please note this job description may not be inclusive of all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described and that additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands. Arkestro reserves the right to change duties, responsibilities and activities at any time with or without notice.
